hero.title: Everyone deserves a network.
hero.body: Social Capital connects you with real professionals — in tech, law, healthcare, trades, media and more — who've agreed to talk. Ask a question, hear their story, or get them to visit your school. It's free, wherever you go to school.

teasers.title: The people who make this work
teasers.body: The directory is being built right now. These are the kinds of people we're asking to join — and if one of them sounds like you, we'd like to hear from you.
teasers.note: Real profiles appear here as mentors join.

items.name: Someone three years in
items.quote: You still remember school. That's most of the qualification.

items.name: Someone who runs the place
items.quote: Twenty years of context a fifteen-year-old has no other way to get.

items.name: Someone who never went to college
items.quote: Paid from year one, no fees. Students are rarely shown this route.

industries.title: Not just the obvious routes
industries.body: Technology, healthcare, law, finance, trades, media and communications, education, engineering, public sector — and more inside. Full profiles are visible once your school registers.

cta.title: Want this at your school?
cta.body: Social Capital only works once a school's registered. If yours isn't yet, tell your guidance counsellor — registration takes a few minutes and it's free.
